decision: Does the data layer provide a more complete, deeper, timely and consistently usable candidate information set without reduced integrity?

population.source: frozen read-only current research database roster; private refs in preflight record
population.protected_scopes: Preserve existing exclusions. Do not read protected report bodies or holdout answers.
population.selection_limit: Current database population, not a reconstructed historical investable universe. Registry gaps retained.

arms.A: Actually available web-search add-ons: runtime information manifest, static capability defaults, supported cache/retry/fallback and typed ingestion. Unavailable/unused features are separately disclosed.
arms.B: Competent normal search and source opening; same eligible historical corpus/backend, model/effort, source access and resources. Common time and safety gates apply.

reference_standard.owner: mentor-side source-grounded hindsight reference, separate from worker context
reference_standard.construction: Systematic dated issuer/technical/legal/customer/contrary source review, including no-change and adverse windows, before comparable worker dispatch. Later outcomes may locate earlier sources but cannot become earlier evidence.
reference_standard.incompleteness: Report bounded reference coverage. Adjudicate valid additional discoveries from the union under unchanged rules, with additions logged and arm identity withheld where possible.
reference_standard.review_limit: No human calibration or protected blindness claimed by model agreement. Modern weight contamination persists.

temporal_gates_required_before_dispatch: Filter source-version availability before emitting result titles, snippets, counts or body content to the worker.
Unknown publication/version times cannot satisfy a strict historical evidence requirement.
Effective date is not publication date. An old heading does not authenticate a newer body.
Apply the same filter to old context, discovery catalogs, redirects, cached payloads and fallback routes.
Cache keys bind source version and cutoff; hits preserve dates and require eligible bytes. No cache poisoning across future and past runs.
Worker accesses only host-approved replay search/open operations; no live web, filesystem, shell or apps. Verify actual tool-event logs.
Oracle references and future information remain host-only. Capability-restricted replay is not an OS isolation claim.
Returned observations bind source version, passage, metric scope and knowledge status; unsupported model-memory facts receive no credit.
critical_failures: any future/oracle information exposed to worker
old date attached to unverified newer body
failed retrieval reported as no change
required case or question silently deleted
counting: Every attempted provider item including failures, retries and alternatives counts. Cache/local calls, model usage and unknown charges are separate. Exact run-level model/call ceilings must be sealed once eligible corpus and executor are known.
rollout: Complete all-entity deterministic inventory/temporal preflight before semantic claims.
Prepare NOW 24-month monthly/event roster, eligible source versions and source-bound reference items.
Run at most ten preselected matched windows including NOW and other database securities; source/readiness strata and adverse/no-change controls frozen before outputs.
Expand to two anchor cutoffs for every current database security in bounded batches; retain unresolved registry labels and all missing/unrun cases.
Add prospective capture to measure real publication-to-ingest lag.
decision_rule: First require no critical integrity failure. Report paired supported additions/misses and resource differences by ticker/event. Support only the measured scope if richness improves without a material integrity/coverage regression within the frozen budget; otherwise tradeoff or inconclusive. No arbitrary significance or forecast threshold.
stopping: Freeze through existing seal/begin/finish before comparable execution. Keep every attempt. New sources/policy/grader require a new version. Stop and diagnose leakage or implementation false blocks; no quality-driven reruns until A wins.
currently_pending: sealed run-level budgets and tool/model pins
